ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution with localized high-intensity (white) focal points; estimated macro-ratio of 1:20 white-to-black surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both fluke lobes. Visible mapping of approximately 30-40 discrete, high-contrast circular white blobs (3-12 pixels in diameter) distributed non-linearly across the central and trailing regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated 55-degree V-shaped angular depression at the central convergence point of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency serrations; peak-to-trough amplitude ranges from 3-10 pixels; more pronounced topographical variation on the distal half of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a deep concave sweep toward the median notch, while leading/outer edges show a convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially clustered circular high-contrast white pixel groups; high density observed in the lower-medial quadrants of both lobes, corresponding to barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, light-grey linear pixel streaks; approximately 3 parallel diagonal marks detected on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rosette-patterned scarring across both lobes; small irregular notch/indentation visible on the extreme left distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of green filamentous high-contrast material (likely macroalgae) entangled near the medial notch region of the right lobe.
